completion_rule: Every field must have a declared model-specific value, versioned supporting artifact and review outcome. A field may be marked not applicable only with an explicit mathematical reason checked against the proposed observable map. A missing bulk model is not supplied by a numerical response certificate.

excluded_shortcuts: use CMB and low-redshift CBC endpoints as if equal
identify fixed-k eikonal phase with CBC Fourier waveform phase
omit common radion friction from a quantitative waveform bound
assign either relation to the current scalar pulse model

fixed_current_experiment.background: four-dimensional de Sitter, H=1 in declared units
fixed_current_experiment.field: minimally coupled scalar, mass squared two
fixed_current_experiment.initial_target: prescribed zero response at eta=-6, exact zero forcing through eta=-5

prohibited_inferences: Ward closure proves the physical origin of forcing
All-node state accuracy identifies dimensional origin
A nonzero excitation coefficient proves thermalization or a hot radiation era
A mean forcing match establishes identical noise or memory
A prior-selected parameter is identified by the likelihood alone
A literature model relation or posterior is automatically an HDBLAST prediction

required_fields.current_scope: Current scalar response has no selected bulk/brane action.
required_fields.name: Bulk and brane action, dimension and signature
required_fields.required_evidence: Full variational action, field content, boundary terms, units and perturbative order; distinguish spacelike from timelike extra directions.
required_fields.review_check: Derive all asserted field equations from the same pinned action.

required_fields.current_scope: H=1 and scalar mass squared two do not derive coupled five-dimensional evolution.
required_fields.name: Background and embedding
required_fields.required_evidence: Bulk solution, brane embedding, Hubble history, domain and approximation errors.
required_fields.review_check: Check coupled background equations and boundary constraints; give the domain of any imposed background approximation.

required_fields.current_scope: A compactly supported effective pulse specifies none of these bulk conditions.
required_fields.name: Bulk boundary and global conditions
required_fields.required_evidence: Topology, compactification, retarded/advanced choice, boundary conditions and global regularity requirements.
required_fields.review_check: Establish that the chosen projected data are realized by the declared bulk; trace flux orientation to boundary conditions.

required_fields.current_scope: The B and zB profiles are controlled inputs, with inherited represented epsilon.
required_fields.name: Source dynamics and normalization
required_fields.required_evidence: Source fields, trajectory or collision dynamics, couplings, normalization and energy supply.
required_fields.review_check: Derive the source rather than selecting its shape after measuring the response.

required_fields.current_scope: The zero prehistory prescription fixes this scalar target, not a physical bulk preparation.
required_fields.name: Initial and environment states
required_fields.required_evidence: Bulk/brane preparation, incoming vacuum or density matrix, bath state and initial correlations.
required_fields.review_check: Check admissibility for the actual operator and boundary geometry; normalization alone is insufficient.

required_fields.current_scope: Incoming matching at eta=-9/2 is a linear-state comparison, not a solved brane junction.
required_fields.name: Junction and mode matching
required_fields.required_evidence: Israel or other action-derived matching conditions, bulk-to-brane Green functions and scalar/tensor/boundary coupling rules.
required_fields.review_check: Match all relevant modes and state data with sign, orientation and contact conventions fixed.

required_fields.current_scope: Current validated experiment specifies g=4L²h-2Lh′-h″ and contains no derived bulk noise or memory kernel.
required_fields.name: Effective forcing and joint kernels
required_fields.required_evidence: Derive g(theta); include retarded memory, noise, higher cumulants, state correlations and other channels when present.
required_fields.review_check: Quantify reduction errors; require causal response, positive noise and applicable state-dependent consistency relations.

required_fields.current_scope: The two-profile linear response has rank at most two; better evaluation creates no origin label.
required_fields.name: Joint observable prediction
required_fields.required_evidence: Map common parameters to at least one additional correlated restriction, with gauge-invariant observables, units and measurement response.
required_fields.review_check: State which observable directions distinguish the restricted model from each rival; demonstrate identifiability or report exact degeneracies.

required_fields.current_scope: No extra-dimensional parameter posterior is defined by the current experiment.
required_fields.name: Parameter domains and priors
required_fields.required_evidence: Parameter definitions, units, supports, fixed values, externally measured information and proper prior choices.
required_fields.review_check: Separate likelihood identification from prior selection; check support and prior-volume sensitivity.

required_fields.current_scope: An unrestricted 4D forcing equal to g gives the same present response under common premises.
required_fields.name: Declared four-dimensional rivals
required_fields.required_evidence: An encompassing effective-input nuisance family plus any restricted physical 4D actions/baths to be compared.
required_fields.review_check: Identify containment or excluded predictions explicitly; retain preparation, source and measurement freedom consistently.

required_fields.current_scope: Fixed scalar evolution is not a complete bulk/brane stability analysis.
required_fields.name: Stability and well-posedness
required_fields.required_evidence: Kinetic signs, gradient/tachyon behavior, hyperbolicity, background and boundary stability, KK spectrum, EFT cutoff.
required_fields.review_check: Verify the actual branch and all relevant sectors over the fitted scales; a positive coefficient in one sector is insufficient.

required_fields.current_scope: A linear mode/Wronskian check does not establish a unitary microscopic completion.
required_fields.name: Unitarity and open-system consistency
required_fields.required_evidence: Closed-theory quantum consistency or admissible reduced evolution; renormalization domain and positivity conditions.
required_fields.review_check: Distinguish unitary closed evolution from dissipative reduced evolution; establish applicable positivity and state constraints.

required_fields.current_scope: Current pulse response supplies neither a bulk energy reservoir nor a hot Big Bang history.
required_fields.name: Energy, flux, backreaction and thermal history
required_fields.required_evidence: Action-derived stress, signed bulk/brane energy ledger, source work, full contacts, gravitational backreaction and thermalization mechanism.
required_fields.review_check: Demonstrate the claimed energy transfer and temperature/history; excitation or a Ward identity alone is insufficient.

required_fields.current_scope: Rao2608.09299v3 and Chen-Zhang2606.14549v1 are model-specific examples, not imported HDBLAST predictions.
required_fields.name: GW and other observational admissibility
required_fields.required_evidence: Derive the propagation/waveform law, source-generation effects, redshift conversion, matching endpoints, friction, calibration and selection model.
required_fields.review_check: Use only data and likelihoods within that model domain; distinguish dispersion, eikonal phase, CBC Fourier phase and amplitude damping.

required_fields.current_scope: Discrete incoming-state certification does not complete the unchanged twelve-case pressure/contact gate or UV tail.
required_fields.name: Numerical and approximation error budget
required_fields.required_evidence: Source/state arithmetic, time and momentum integration, contacts, cutoff and UV errors, nonlinear truncation and reproducible implementation pins.
required_fields.review_check: Propagate every relevant error to the declared observables before comparing model restrictions.

required_fields.current_scope: No observational likelihood is evaluated by this document or its manufactured examples.
required_fields.name: Measurement, likelihood and prospective test
required_fields.required_evidence: Data provenance, observed unit, calibration/systematics, joint likelihood, nuisance treatment, holdout and predeclared comparison statistic.
required_fields.review_check: Prohibit selecting profiles, restrictions, priors or cuts after seeing the claimed test outcome without a separately labeled exploratory analysis.

required_fields.current_scope: No current result establishes a higher-dimensional cause; external novelty remains unassessed.
required_fields.name: Decision and explanatory scope
required_fields.required_evidence: Define what falsifies the selected action/premises, what supports it over named rivals, and what remains observationally equivalent.
required_fields.review_check: Report model-specific rejection/support separately from a dimensional detection or a claim of cosmological origin.
